job.question: In the Grand Rapids General Retirement System investment consultant RFP, what was the total market value of the General Retirement System and as of what date?
job.expected_facts: Approximately $437 million as of June 30, 2023 (the separate Grand Rapids Police and Fire Retirement System covered by the same RFP was approximately $479 million).
job.acceptance: Require $437m approximately and June 30, 2023. Separate Police and Fire amount is optional.

reviews.reason: This is the Anchorage Police and Fire Retirement System’s 2025 RFP, not the Grand Rapids General Retirement System investment consultant RFP. Its market values are for a different system and date; it does not support the required approximately $437 million as of June 30, 2023.
quotes: This Request for Proposal (RFP) is issued by the Anchorage Police and Fire Retirement System.
As of December 31, 2024, the pension plans had a total market value as follows:
Defined Benefit Plans I, II, III $ 333.7 million
